question: Which country won the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
answer: Spain won the 2026 FIFA World Cup, beating Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final on 19 July 2026 [1]. Ferran Torres scored the winner in the 106th minute [3]. It was Spain's second World Cup title after 2010 [1]. AP's results page also lists the final as Spain 1-0 Argentina [5].

keyPoints.text: Spain won the 2026 FIFA World Cup final, beating Argentina 1-0 after extra time at New York New Jersey Stadium.
Ferran Torres scored the winning goal in extra time (106th minute) for Spain.
This was Spain's second men's World Cup title, following their 2010 win.
Spain's victory is also reflected in the AP schedule, which lists the final as ESP 1, ARG 0.
